ratios.withheld_reason: Withheld: 9M 2026 and H1 2026 are not the same kind of period, so a percentage change between them would compare part of a year with a whole one

valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2025, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pePeriodNote: P/E and the income multiples stand on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file, not on 9M 2026, the newest period on file, which is an interim and is not annualised
valuation.note: P/E stands on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file; the statement and the ratios above are 9M 2026, an interim and not annualised.
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2025 divided by the shares on file
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2025, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 9e+09 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_NGX.json)
valuation.peg_withheld_reason: Withheld: a compound growth rate of earnings is not defined from the periods on file: it needs net profit POSITIVE in BOTH endpoint years (FY2021 and FY2025), and one of them is not. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.peRouteNote: the two P/E routes differ (market cap over net profit 201.84, price over EPS 47.93); the net-profit row reconciles with the filing's own profit before tax less tax, so the EPS row is the one filed in a different unit
valuation.pb_withheld_reason: Withheld: the P/B computed from the inputs on file (3451) is not a valuation for a real business. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
